scientific_integrity: All identities proved by finite-population coupling and binomial algebra. Finite reproducibility tests support the proof but cannot establish infinite parameter coverage. A self-review is not an independent audit.
scientific_limitations: Uniform groups sampled without replacement, ≥2 required cooperators, linear group benefit above threshold, and constant cost; payoff-advantage modes and sign regions, not stochastic fixation probability or spatial games. Closely related historical variants could contain an unnoticed equivalent formula.
title: Exact finite-population cooperation-advantage peak in threshold collective action
